title: Criminal Mischief
grade_or_penalty: 2nd degree if damage is $75,000 or more or disrupts certain public services; 3rd degree if $2,000 or more; 4th degree if over $500 but under $2,000; disorderly persons if $500 or less
key_points: Purposely or knowingly damaging tangible property of another, or recklessly damaging it with fire, explosives or other dangerous means.
Also covers tampering with property of another so as to endanger a person or property.
elements: The suspect purposely or knowingly damaged tangible property of another (OR recklessly or negligently damaged it with fire, explosives or other dangerous means)
OR tampered with tangible property of another so as to endanger a person or property
Determine the dollar amount of damage (sets the grade)

subsections.label: a(1)
subsections.text: Purposely or knowingly damages tangible property of another (or recklessly or negligently with fire, explosives or other dangerous means)

subsections.label: a(2)
subsections.text: Purposely, knowingly or recklessly tampers with tangible property of another so as to endanger a person or property

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: Grading: $2,000+ = 3rd degree; over $500 to under $2,000 = 4th degree; $500 or less = DP. Higher grades for damage to utilities, transportation, research facilities, and similar targets
